verdict.rationale: Docs describe saved-profile login persistence and a 2FA workflow where the first run pauses at the 2FA screen and a human enters the code via live view, plus a human-checkpoint fallback — but there is no vault/secrets-manager integration for storing credentials separately from the model, nor automated TOTP handling; the model/agent still interacts with the login flow directly rather than credentials being injected without exposure. missing for 10: dedicated credential vault integration, secret-injection so raw credentials/TOTP seeds are never seen by the model, automated TOTP generation, independent/hands-on confirmation of the 2FA workflow working reliably.
